# Hand-written triggers (NOT regenerated by scripts/advance_parser.py).
#
# One trigger per Community Mod Menu setting. Each is true when the setting is
# enabled. Every setting defaults to ON, so these deliberately FAIL OPEN: if
# registration has not run yet, the feature is treated as enabled.
#
# Why fail open: CMF fires cmf_on_mod_registration from its yearly
# human-country pulse. Until that runs, "global_variable_map(cmm|flag:...)"
# reads 0 with no error, so gating strictly on ">= 1" silently disabled the mod
# (e.g. right after loading a save, or in the first year of a new game).
# rl_cmf_register sets the rl_settings_ready global variable when it runs.
#
# Why these are NOT one parameterised trigger: the setting key sits inside a
# quoted script expression, and a $param$ is not substituted inside the quotes,
# so a generic "europa_survivors__$s$" lookup silently resolves to nothing and
# reads 0 -- which disabled every feature. CMF itself only ever hardcodes the
# key in these expressions. Hence one explicit trigger per setting.

rl_enabled_roll_on_research = {
    OR = {
        NOT = { has_global_variable = rl_settings_ready }
        "global_variable_map(cmm|flag:europa_survivors__roll_on_research)" >= 1
    }
}

rl_enabled_roll_on_battle = {
    OR = {
        NOT = { has_global_variable = rl_settings_ready }
        "global_variable_map(cmm|flag:europa_survivors__roll_on_battle)" >= 1
    }
}

    OR = {
        NOT = { has_global_variable = rl_settings_ready }
        "global_variable_map(cmm|flag:europa_survivors__roll_on_new_age)" >= 1
    }
}

# Chaos Draft is a game rule (Game Rules > Flavor), not a CMF setting: it has
# to be chosen before the game starts, when the CMF menu cannot be opened.
# Lists the "on" settings rather than NOT off, so it fails closed.
rl_enabled_chaos_draft = {
    OR = {
        has_game_rule = rl_chaos_draft_50
        has_game_rule = rl_chaos_draft_100
        has_game_rule = rl_chaos_draft_250
        has_game_rule = rl_chaos_draft_500
    }
}

# A country that can turn against root over its notoriety (scope: that
# country). Allies, root's subjects and root's overlord stay loyal.
rl_backlash_eligible = {
    NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
    NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
    NOT = { root = { is_subject_of = prev } }
}

# Starting boons are on unless the rl_boons game rule turns them off.
rl_enabled_boons = {
    NOT = { has_game_rule = rl_boons_off }
}
